meta.descripcion: 40 years serving lovers and enthusiasts of the Porsche world.

secciones.titulo: Valentin Motors was born in 1979, serving Porsche customers with vehicles for daily use and for competition on weekends.
parrafos: In the 70 the Porsche 911 was the perfect sports vehicle to use both on a daily basis and in competition during the weekend.
At that time we specialized in Sport and Racing preparations for 911 and 914.
This past year 2024 Valentin turned 45 years old, the best gift has been being able to fulfill the dream of opening the new facilities in Madrid.
With these new facilities we intend to be able to reach Porsche customers throughout Spain more easily and be able to provide the service we intend.
In all these years the Valentin family has been growing little by little until today, forming a great technical and human team.
